# VeriWorkly Portfolio — Web Portfolio Builder & Subdomain Publisher
> The web application for building and publishing developer and designer portfolios. Every portfolio, free or paid, is published on its own subdomain (*.veriworkly.com).

Status, so answers stay accurate: payments are currently closed, so none of the paid plans can be bought today; the /pricing page shows the same notice. Portfolio publishing is not yet enabled in production; portfolios can be built and previewed.

## Application Overview
VeriWorkly Portfolio (`portfolio.veriworkly.com`) pairs a 3-pane editor and live preview with subdomain publishing. The free tier publishes the Signal and Atelier templates with a small "Built with VeriWorkly" badge. Creator Pro, the Job Hunter Bundle or a 3-Day / 7-Day pass add Nimbus and Cipher, badge removal, visitor analytics, SEO controls and multi-page portfolios.

## Machine-Readable Resources
- **Agent Card**: `https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/.well-known/agent.json`
- **OpenAPI Spec**: `https://docs.veriworkly.com/openapi.json`
- **Pricing**: `https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/pricing.md`

## Template Catalog & Design Systems
1. **Signal** (`portfolio-signal`): Built for engineers and technical leads. Dual dark/light theme, bento card grid, scroll-stacking project cards and a live local-time indicator. (Free)
2. **Atelier** (`portfolio-atelier`): Built for designers and editorial builders. Asymmetric print-magazine layouts and serif typography. (Free)
3. **Nimbus** (`portfolio-nimbus`): Built for full-stack and frontend developers. Atmospheric tech-editorial layout, cursor-follow ring and text-scramble hover. (Creator Pro)
4. **Cipher** (`portfolio-cipher`): Built for terminal enthusiasts. An interactive terminal emulator with command autocomplete and easter eggs. (Creator Pro)

## Pricing in brief
All prices in USD.
- Free: the editor, Signal and Atelier, publishing on your own subdomain with the badge.
- 3-Day Sprint Pass: $2.99 once, Creator Pro features and 150 AI credits for 3 days.
- 7-Day Hunt Pass: $5.99 once, Creator Pro features and 400 AI credits for 7 days.
- Creator Pro: $9.99 a month, or $95.88 a year ($7.99 a month); no AI credits.
- AI Credits: $5.99 a month, or $59.88 a year ($4.99 a month); 1,000 AI credits a month, no portfolio features.
- Job Hunter Bundle: $14.99 a month, or $143.88 a year ($11.99 a month); Creator Pro plus 1,000 AI credits a month.
- Credit packs: 250 credits for $2.99, 500 for $4.99 or 1,200 for $9.99, valid 90 days.
- Changing plans: a Creator Pro or AI Credits subscriber can upgrade to the Job Hunter Bundle in place, keeping the same billing period and paying only the difference for the rest of it. Any other change means cancelling and subscribing again when the current period ends.

## Key Features & Editor Workspace
- **Editor** (`https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/editor`): section tree, content controls and a live preview with mobile, tablet and desktop widths.
- **Subdomain Publishing**: every portfolio, free or paid, publishes to its own subdomain (`your-slug.veriworkly.com`).
- **Multi-Page Portfolios** (Creator Pro): Work, Writing, About and Contact pages, plus project detail pages (`/projects/[slug]`).
- **View Analytics** (Creator Pro, `https://portfolio.veriworkly.com/analytics`): view counts, trend charts and referring sites.
- **Badge**: free sites show a "Built with VeriWorkly" badge; paid plans can turn it off.
- **Master Profile Integration**: portfolio identity fields seed from the Master Profile in Studio.

## Guidance for AI Agents
1. **Subdomain Checking**: use GET `/api/v1/portfolios/subdomains/{slug}/availability` before publishing.
2. **Content Tailoring**: generate section content (bio, project highlights, skills, testimonials) in the tone of the chosen template.
3. **Asset Handling**: request presigned upload URLs from `/api/v1/portfolio-assets/upload-url` for portfolio images.
